thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-4218 fired for service: autoscaler-queue-saturation - queue backlog > 95% for 5m - affected: serving/hosted-inference-us-west - severity: P2. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/P-4218>

pagerduty: Incident P-4218 assigned to maria.

maria: Ack. I'm on it. Checking dashboards.

jon: I see a big spike in ingress (3x tokens/sec). Autoscaler pods stuck in Pending, a bunch of "ContainerCreating" and some Node quota errors in the cluster.

maria: Quick log snippet from scale-controller: 
```
E0321 12:34:22.123 scale_controller.go:412] failed to create node: quotaExceeded: Insufficient quota
```

sarah: Could be the analytics retrain job that started at 12:20 in a different project, maybe noisy scheduling. I'm pulling job list now.

maria: Ok. Going to try manual mitigations: routing and manual scale. Preparing runbook steps.

leo: Manual scale attempt (running command now): `kubectl -n redwood scale deployment autoscaler-serving --replicas=20`

leo: Some pods still Pending with `InsufficientInstanceQuota` and `failed to attach volume` style errors.

maria: Reached out to infra for emergency quota bump. @oncall-shadow can you start customer comms?

oncall-shadow: Picking this up. Drafting status update: "We're seeing elevated inference queueing in US-WEST causing higher latencies for some customers. Mitigation steps underway (traffic reroute, manual scale). We'll update in 30m."

infra-bot: Cloud provider ticket created: TKT-99823 — ETA 45-60m for quota approval.

jon: While we wait, reducing per-request footprint to relieve scheduling pressure. Deploying small batch config patch: `SERVICE_BATCH_SIZE=4 -> 2`.

maria: Patch rolled. Observability: backlog down ~20% in 3m, but p95 tail still elevated for long-seq customers.

sarah: Found a noisy cron in analytics namespace hitting model download endpoint every 10s. Throttling it and disabling next scheduled run.

maria: Nice catch. Killed cron job `cron-reindex-7` and scaled its job to 0 replicas.

pagerduty: Incident P-4218 escalated to oncall-2 due to >15m without full resolution.

leo: Can we route low-tier and non-prod customers to a smaller model variant to take load off the hot path? Suggest temporary routing rule to small-quant model.

jon: Applying routing change now: `route: hosted-inference-us-west -> model-variant: small-quant (non-prod, free-tier)`

maria: After routing change + batch reduction, Q backlog continues to drop. CPU pressure on nodes reduced. Monitoring dashboards show queue depth trending down.

oncall-shadow: Posted customer update to status page and sent targeted messages to affected customers: "Mitigations in progress; expect intermittent latency improvements. Next update in 30 minutes."

infra-bot: Quota bump approved. Provisioning 10 additional nodes.

maria: New nodes joining the cluster, scheduler placing pending pods. Autoscaler can now schedule previously pending replicas. Queue draining.

leo: Verified: active queue < 30%, p95 latency back to baseline for most customers. Some long-seq requests still trickling but manageable.

maria: Preparing to resolve PD after a short observation window. Creating follow-up tasks: runbook improvements and postmortem.

sarah: Filing postmortem ticket PM-342 with initial timelines and suspected root cause (cross-project noisy cron + quota exhaustion + lack of automatic fallback routing).

jon: Also making an alert to detect sudden cross-namespace spikes hitting hosting endpoints and a guard to automatically lower batch sizes when node pressure > 85%.

maria: Great. Thanks all. :thumbsup: Marking incident Resolved in PagerDuty when stable.

pagerduty: Incident P-4218 resolved by maria at 3135792599.

leo: Leaving follow-up checklist in the ticket: (1) add auto-fallback routing, (2) tighten quota monitoring, (3) remediate noisy analytics cron, (4) update runbook.

maria: Will add owners and ETA to PM-342. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
